text: Most of the week's 70 pull requests change behaviour, mainly through fixes in BCApps. VAT regressions seen since Business Central 28.4 are addressed in #13085 and #12982, and #13107 adds schema, integrity and size checks to the CZ ARES registration lookup. Cost and posting fixes include #12868 (Adjust Cost rounding variance), #11894 (mixed-currency totals in Close Income Statement), #12201 (non-deductible VAT on foreign-currency projects) and #11998 (missing General Posting Setup combination). Subscription Billing gets #10444, #12767, #12967 and #10477. Subcontracting fixes are #12783, #12584, #11665 and #12986. Expense Agent adds alternate approvers in #11955 and enforced itemization in #12599, plus #13058. Credit memos recognised from PDFs arrive in #12855 and #12894. French features move out of base layers into apps in #13054, #9104 and #9143, while #12160 moves French accelerated depreciation into the W1 base application. In AL-Go, #2293 adds protectedSettings, #2407 supports GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency, and #2402 adds a built-in Copilot review, limited to opt-in triggers by #2413. Extensibility changes include #10384 and #13075. #12186 merges ModifyAll calls; where RunTrigger is passed, OnModify now runs once per row, not once per field. #12607 speeds up the Belgian Purchase Ledger. BCQuality added knowledge articles and plan guidance, for example #246 and #229.

issues: #12160 moves French accelerated depreciation into the W1 base application; it does not move a French feature out of base layers. Only #13054, #9104 and #9143 fit that description.
#12186: OnModify runs once per row only where RunTrigger was passed, instead of once per field. The original states this without the condition.
